item.title: Labor Behind the Interface — what is demonstrable?
item.lead: Investigative journalism has made the workplace more concrete, but the series must continue to distinguish between case studies and the sector.

blocks.text: In 2024, Reuters reported on chatters and AI tools; WIRED described undercover work as a chatter. These sources make it plausible that ghostwriting and commercial conversation management are not a fictitious marginal phenomenon.
For sector-wide statements, a representative sample remains necessary. A professional edition should therefore rather state “documented at investigated agencies/accounts” than “the sector does this.”

A future study can code job vacancies, training materials, pay structures, shift schedules, and software permissions. This can investigate how often impersonation, upselling, and retention occur as formal tasks.

blocks.label: STRONG FORMULATION
blocks.text: “Documented in investigated cases” is stronger than an unproven sector percentage.
